id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

job.description: Reference to the corresponding {@link UiBundler} job.

sharedRuntimeExecutorSetupTime.description: The time spent setting up the shared runtime executor, in seconds.

totalSetupWorkingDirTime.description: The grand total of all setupWorkingDir times, in seconds.

totalBundlerRunTime.description: The grand total time to run the bundler, in seconds.

totalBundlingTime.description: The grand total of all bundling times, in seconds.

totalWebpackTime.description: The grand total of all {@link Webpack} times, in seconds.

totalFileUploadTime.description: The grand total of all file uploading times, in seconds.

totalWriteContentsTime.description: The grand total of all write contents times, in seconds.

totalFileNumbers.description: The total number of files upldoaded.

totalFileUploadSize.description: The size of the uploaded files.

batchProcessingStartTime.description: The time at which this job's batch processing phase was started.

batchProcessingEndTime.description: The time at which this job's batch processing phase was completed.

totalBatchProcessingTime.description: The total time spent processing batches, in seconds.

allCompleteTime.description: The time it took for {@link UiBundler#allComplete} to run, in seconds.

jobStartTime.description: The time at which this job was started.

jobEndTime.description: The time at which this job was completed.

totalTime.description: The total duration of the job, in seconds.

batchNumber.description: The total number of batches processed.
